parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: Specifies the source Protocol of the RadSecProxy service.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: The IP interface which the RadSecProxy service uses as the source for the corresponding {{param|Protocol}}.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Specifies the port used to receive corresponding {{param|Protocol}} packets. UDP {{param|Protocol}} will default to port 1812 and TCP and TLS {{param|Protocol}} will default to 2083.

object.description: Specifies the source configurations of the RadSecProxy service which is used for connecting to servers in order to send messages for each type of {{param|Protocol}}.
